name: Dreams Jade Resort & Spa

kids_club.evidence: Explorer's Club (3-12) is included and open 9am-10pm daily, with parents given pagers; recent reviews name and praise individual staff. Ongoing construction and the planned adults-only conversion cloud whether it will run as now in April 2027.

water_play.evidence: Three heated pools including a shallow kids' pool, but no water slides or splash park; families have noted the lack.

beach.evidence: Swimming is in a rock-enclosed section of a modest beach with some rocks and weed; 2025-26 reviews report heavy sargassum, with some guests unable to use the beach despite daily raking.

rooms.evidence: Base Junior Suites are about 700 sq ft with two double beds available, and Family Suites are two connecting Junior Suites.

food.evidence: Six à la carte venues on paper, but 2026 reviews report Spice closed for renovation, the buffet shut at dinner and only about three restaurants open some nights; dinner dress code applies.

transfer.evidence: About 12 miles from CUN; sources quote 15-30 minutes.

condition.evidence: Opened 2008, last major refresh around 2020-21; 2026 reviews describe construction noise, closed areas, broken elevators and worn rooms. A conversion to an adults-only Secrets was announced for November 2025 but had not happened as of February 2026, and its timing is unverified.

kids_club.name: Explorer's Club
kids_club.notes: Pagers for parents; activities include crafts, movie nights and beach campouts. Could disappear if the resort converts to an adults-only Secrets; check status before booking.

pros: Kids' club open until 10pm at no charge
Junior Suites are large, with two double beds
Heated pools, including a shallow kids' pool
cons: Planned conversion to an adults-only Secrets resort, timing unverified, could affect an April 2027 booking
Construction in 2026, with restaurant closures and noise
No water slides or splash pad for young children
Rocky swim area and repeated sargassum complaints
verdict: Hard to recommend for April 2027 while construction runs and the adults-only conversion is unresolved, and it offers little water play for young children.
